description:
segments: {total, offset, returned, segments}. Each segment has its
segment_number (the handle segment tools take), kind (image, clip,
talking head, real photo, B-roll or overlay segment), narration,
duration, direction, image_prompt, video_prompt (the motion when
animated), media_queries (searches for a real photo or B-roll), the
characters, environments and objects it shows, continues_from_segment
(its image continues that earlier segment's image) and its assets.

segment_assets: {segment_number, assets}: its image, clip, real photos,
overlays and sound effects, each with kind, status, prompt, model,
earlier_renders (what a rollback can restore) and public_url (for
view_image).

action.description: segments: the storyboard, paged; segment_assets: one segment's assets (segment_number)

limit.description: segments: how many; 0 returns all. Long videos have 100+, so page.

name: storyboard_read
title: Read the storyboard
